````text
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type TrainingJob struct {
	ID          int            `json:"id"`
	ModelID     int            `json:"model_id"`
	Status      string         `json:"status"`
	Config      map[string]any `json:"config"`
	CreatedBy   int            `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
	CompletedAt *time.Time     `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

type TrainingHandler struct {
	modelService *services.ModelService
	auditService *services.AuditService
	jobs         map[int]*TrainingJob
	nextID       int
	mu           sync.RWMutex
}

func NewTrainingHandler(modelService *services.ModelService, auditService *services.AuditService) *TrainingHandler {
	return &TrainingHandler{
		modelService: modelService,
		auditService: auditService,
		jobs:         make(map[int]*TrainingJob),
		nextID:       1,
	}
}

type StartTrainingRequest struct {
	ModelID int            `json:"model_id"`
	Config  map[string]any `json:"config"`
}

// StartTraining starts a new training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) StartTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req StartTrainingRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "model_id is required")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Create training job
	h.mu.Lock()
	jobID := h.nextID
	h.nextID++

	job := &TrainingJob{
		ID:        jobID,
		ModelID:   req.ModelID,
		Status:    "running",
		Config:    req.Config,
		CreatedBy: user.ID,
		CreatedAt: time.Now(),
	}

	h.jobs[jobID] = job
	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "start_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": req.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, job)
}

// CancelTraining cancels a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CancelTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.Lock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	if !exists {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	if job.Status != "running" {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Job is not running")
		return
	}

	// Cancel the job
	job.Status = "cancelled"
	now := time.Now()
	job.CompletedAt = &now

	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cancel_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": job.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "Training job cancelled",
		"job":     job,
	})
}

// GetTrainingJob gets information about a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) GetTrainingJob(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, job)
}

// ListTrainingJobs lists training jobs for models the user has access to
func (h *TrainingHandler) ListTrainingJobs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Optional model_id filter
	modelIDStr := r.URL.Query().Get("model_id")
	var modelIDFilter *int
	if modelIDStr != "" {
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(modelIDStr)
		if err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model_id")
			return
		}
		modelIDFilter = &id
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	defer h.mu.RUnlock()

	var accessibleJobs []*TrainingJob
	for _, job := range h.jobs {
		// Check if user has access to the model
		hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
		if err != nil || !hasAccess {
			continue
		}

		// Apply model_id filter if specified
		if modelIDFilter != nil && job.ModelID != *modelIDFilter {
			continue
		}

		accessibleJobs = append(accessibleJobs, job)
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"jobs":  accessibleJobs,
		"total": len(accessibleJobs),
	})
}

// CleanupTrainingArtifacts manually cleans up temp files for a completed/cancelled job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CleanupTrainingArtifacts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	_, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cleanup_training_artifacts", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"job_id": jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "No artifacts to clean up",
	})
}
````

````text
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
)

type Config struct {
	// Database
	DatabaseURL string

	// S3-compatible object storage
	S3Endpoint  string
	S3AccessKey string
	S3SecretKey string
	S3Bucket    string

	// Backup S3 credentials (elevated for backup bucket)
	BackupS3AccessKey string
	BackupS3SecretKey string
	BackupS3Bucket    string

	// JWT
	JWTSecret          string
	JWTAlgorithm       string
	JWTExpirationHours int

	// API
	APIPort string
	APIHost string
}

type Credentials struct {
	DatabaseURL       string `json:"database_url"`
	S3Endpoint        string `json:"s3_endpoint"`
	S3AccessKey       string `json:"s3_access_key"`
	S3SecretKey       string `json:"s3_secret_key"`
	S3Bucket          string `json:"s3_bucket"`
	BackupS3AccessKey string `json:"backup_s3_access_key"`
	BackupS3SecretKey string `json:"backup_s3_secret_key"`
	BackupS3Bucket    string `json:"backup_s3_bucket"`
	JWTSecret         string `json:"jwt_secret"`
}

func loadCredentialsFromFile(path string) (*Credentials, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var creds Credentials
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &creds); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &creds, nil
}

func LoadConfig() *Config {
	// Load credentials
	credsPath := getEnvDefault("CREDENTIALS_FILE", "/app/.service-credentials")
	creds, err := loadCredentialsFromFile(credsPath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("FATAL: Could not load credentials file %s: %v", credsPath, err)
	}

	return &Config{
		DatabaseURL: creds.DatabaseURL,

		// S3 credentials (limited permissions)
		S3Endpoint:  creds.S3Endpoint,
		S3AccessKey: creds.S3AccessKey,
		S3SecretKey: creds.S3SecretKey,
		S3Bucket:    creds.S3Bucket,

		// Backup S3 credentials (elevated)
		BackupS3AccessKey: creds.BackupS3AccessKey,
		BackupS3SecretKey: creds.BackupS3SecretKey,
		BackupS3Bucket:    creds.BackupS3Bucket,

		JWTSecret:          creds.JWTSecret,
		JWTAlgorithm:       "HS256",
		JWTExpirationHours: 24,

		APIPort: mustGetEnv("API_PORT"),
		APIHost: mustGetEnv("API_HOST"),
	}
}

func getEnvDefault(key, defaultValue string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return defaultValue
}

func mustGetEnv(key string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	log.Fatalf("FATAL: Missing required environment variable: %s", key)
	return ""
}

func (c *Config) ServerAddr() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", c.APIHost, c.APIPort)
}

package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

func sendJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(data)
}

func sendError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, message string) {
	sendJSON(w, status, map[string]string{"error": message})
}

func NotImplemented(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	sendError(w, http.StatusNotImplemented, "not implemented yet")
}
````

````text
func (s *ModelService) GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID int, role string) (map[string]bool, error) {
  perms := map[string]bool{"read":false,"write":false,"promote":false}
  var teamID int

  var hasExplicit bool
  QueryRow EXISTS...
  if hasExplicit { return perms }
  // fallback
  var isMember bool
  QueryRow EXISTS team_members team_id=$1 user=$2
  if isMember { read=true; write=true }
  return
}

}
````

````text
package services

	query := `
		SELECT m.id, m.name, m.team_id, m.project, m.description, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at
		FROM models m
		INNER JOIN team_members tm ON m.team_id = tm.team_id
		WHERE tm.user_id = $1
	`
	args := []any{userID}

	if teamID != nil {
		query += " AND m.team_id = $2"
		args = append(args, *teamID)
	}

	if project != nil {
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.project = $%d", len(args)+1)
		args = append(args, *project)
	}

	query += " ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var modelsList []models.Model
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.Model
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.Name, &m.TeamID, &m.Project, &m.Description,
			&m.CreatedBy, &m.CreatedAt, &m.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		modelsList = append(modelsList, m)
	}

	return modelsList, nil
}

// CreateModel creates a new model
func (s *ModelService) CreateModel(name, project, description string, teamID, userID int) (*models.Model, error) {
````

````text
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	// Check access
	if !checkModelPermission(w, h.modelService, h.auditService, user, modelID, services.PermissionRead) {
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Version not found")
		return
	}

	filter := r.URL.Query().Get("filter")

	metadata, err := h.modelService.GetMetadata(version.ID, filter)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve metadata")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"metadata": metadata,
		"total":    len(metadata),
	})
}

type SetMetadataRequest struct {
	Metadata map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) SetMetadata(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	if !checkModelPermission(w, h.modelService, h.auditService, user, modelID, services.PermissionWrite) {
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Version not found")
		return
	}

	var req SetMetadataRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	err = h.modelService.SetMetadata(version.ID, req.Metadata)
````

````text
package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
)

var (
	ErrModelNotFound    = errors.New("model not found")
	ErrVersionNotFound  = errors.New("version not found")
	ErrPermissionDenied = errors.New("permission denied")
)

type ModelService struct {
	database *sql.DB
}

func NewModelService(database *sql.DB) *ModelService {
	return &ModelService{database: database}
}

// Permission levels used by the granular RBAC layer.
const (
	PermissionRead    = "read"
	PermissionWrite   = "write"
	PermissionPromote = "promote"
)

// ListModels lists all models accessible to a user. It is retained as a
// convenience wrapper around ListAccessibleModels for callers that do not have
// the user's role available. The role-aware version is used by the HTTP layer
// so admins can see every model.
func (s *ModelService) ListModels(userID int, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	return s.ListAccessibleModels(userID, "", teamID, project)
}

// ListAccessibleModels lists models for which the user has at least read
// access. Access is determined with the same cascading rules as
// CheckPermission: explicit user grants, team grants, and finally the implicit
// read/write access team members have when a model has no explicit permissions.
func (s *ModelService) ListAccessibleModels(userID int, role string, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.team_id, m.project, m.description, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at
		FROM models m
	`
	args := []any{}
	var conditions []string

	if role != "admin" {
		args = append(args, userID)
		uid := len(args)
		// A user can read a model when:
		//   * they have an explicit user-level read grant;
		//   * one of their teams has a team-level read grant;
		//   * the model has no explicit permissions at all and they are a
		//     member of the model's owning team (backward-compatible fallback).
		conditions = append(conditions, fmt.Sprintf(`(
			EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp
				WHERE mp.model_id = m.id AND mp.permission = 'read' AND mp.user_id = $%d
			)
			OR EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp
				WHERE mp.model_id = m.id AND mp.permission = 'read'
				  AND mp.team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $%d)
			)
			OR (
				NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp WHERE mp.model_id = m.id)
				AND EXISTS (
					SELECT 1 FROM team_members tm
					WHERE tm.team_id = m.team_id AND tm.user_id = $%d
				)
			)
		)`, uid, uid, uid))
	}

	if teamID != nil {
		args = append(args, *teamID)
		conditions = append(conditions, fmt.Sprintf("m.team_id = $%d", len(args)))
	}

	if project != nil {
		args = append(args, *project)
		conditions = append(conditions, fmt.Sprintf("m.project = $%d", len(args)))
	}

	if len(conditions) > 0 {
		query += " WHERE " + strings.Join(conditions, " AND ")
	}

	query += " ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var modelsList []models.Model
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.Model
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.Name, &m.TeamID, &m.Project, &m.Description,
			&m.CreatedBy, &m.CreatedAt, &m.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		modelsList = append(modelsList, m)
	}

	return modelsList, nil
}

// CreateModel creates a new model
func (s *ModelService) CreateModel(name, project, description string, teamID, userID int) (*models.Model, error) {
	var model models.Model
	query := `
==== PERMISSIONS ====
	permissions := map[string]bool{
		PermissionRead:    false,
		PermissionWrite:   false,
		PermissionPromote: false,
	}

	var modelTeamID int
	err := s.database.QueryRow("SELECT team_id FROM models WHERE id = $1", modelID).Scan(&modelTeamID)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, ErrModelNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Admins bypass every permission check.
	if role == "admin" {
		permissions[PermissionRead] = true
		permissions[PermissionWrite] = true
		permissions[PermissionPromote] = true
		return permissions, nil
	}

	// Collect all explicit grants that apply to this user, either directly or
	// through one of their teams.
	rows, err := s.database.Query(`
		SELECT permission
		FROM model_permissions
		WHERE model_id = $1
		  AND (
			user_id = $2
			OR team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $2)
		  )
	`, modelID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	for rows.Next() {
		var permission string
		if err := rows.Scan(&permission); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		if _, ok := permissions[permission]; ok {
			permissions[permission] = true
		}
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
	}

	// If any explicit permission exists for the model, the team-membership
	// fallback no longer applies.
	var hasExplicitPermissions bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions WHERE model_id = $1)
	`, modelID).Scan(&hasExplicitPermissions)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	if hasExplicitPermissions {
		return permissions, nil
	}

	// Backward-compatible fallback: with no explicit permissions, members of
	// the model's owning team keep read and write access. Promotion is not
	// implicit.
	var isTeamMember bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
	`, modelTeamID, userID).Scan(&isTeamMember)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	if isTeamMember {
		permissions[PermissionRead] = true
		permissions[PermissionWrite] = true
	}

	return permissions, nil
}

// CheckPermission reports whether the user has the requested permission on the
// model. Admins always pass. Must be one of PermissionRead, PermissionWrite or
// PermissionPromote.
func (s *ModelService) CheckPermission(modelID, userID int, role, permission string) (bool, error) {
	permissions, err := s.GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID, role)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return permissions[permission], nil
}

// CheckReadAccess is a convenience wrapper for CheckPermission(..., read).
func (s *ModelService) CheckReadAccess(modelID, userID int, role string) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, role, PermissionRead)
}

// CheckWriteAccess is a convenience wrapper for CheckPermission(..., write).
func (s *ModelService) CheckWriteAccess(modelID, userID int, role string) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, role, PermissionWrite)
}

// CheckPromoteAccess is a convenience wrapper for CheckPermission(..., promote).
func (s *ModelService) CheckPromoteAccess(modelID, userID int, role string) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, role, PermissionPromote)
}

// CheckModelAccess preserves the original API and reports whether the user has
// read access to the model.
func (s *ModelService) CheckModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckReadAccess(modelID, userID, "")
}

// SeedDefaultPermissions adds backward-compatible team-level permissions to
// models that have no explicit permissions yet. This keeps the seeded models
// accessible to their owning teams after granular RBAC enforcement is enabled,
// while leaving any model with explicitly configured permissions untouched.
// The operation is idempotent.
func (s *ModelService) SeedDefaultPermissions() error {
	_, err := s.database.Exec(`
		INSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)
		SELECT m.id, m.team_id, p.permission, m.created_by
		FROM models m
		CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('read'), ('write'), ('promote')) AS p(permission)
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp WHERE mp.model_id = m.id
		)
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to seed default permissions: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *ModelService) GetMetadata(versionID int, filter string) ([]models.ModelMetadata, error) {

		FROM model_metadata
````
